name: location
description: the location of channel within the subject e.g. brain region

name: group
description: a reference to the ElectrodeGroup this electrode is a part of

name: group_name
description: the name of the ElectrodeGroup this electrode is a part of

name: spike_times
description: the spike times for each unit

name: electrodes
description: the electrodes that each spike unit came from

name: waveform_mean
description: the spike waveform mean for each spike unit

name: waveform_sd
description: the spike waveform standard deviation for each spike unit

name: snr
description: The signal-to-noise ratio of the unit.

name: firing_rate
description: Number of spikes per unit of time.

name: peak_to_valley
description: The duration between the negative and the positive peaks computed on the maximum channel.
